unlisted_practices: Involve primary care clinicians and stakeholders heavily in the development, piloting, vetting, implementation, and monitoring of AI/ML tools for primary care.
Policy makers should not assume that AI/ML tools will improve primary care quality, safety, or work life without evidence.
Route synthesized AI/ML information to front-line clinicians rather than only to administrative layers of the health system hierarchy.

screen.reason: This is a commentary/perspective article applying complexity science frameworks to consider the deployment, governance, and limitations of AI/ML in primary care.
